label: EEG recording
overview: Load scalp EEG and seizure annotations for one study subject.
technical: EDF + summary text; normalise names and align 22 bipolar channels.

label: Preprocess
overview: Remove out-of-band activity while preserving the waveform timing.

label: Segment + label
overview: Divide the recording into short windows and mark seizure overlap.
technical: Non-overlapping 2 s epochs; any annotation overlap gives label 1.

label: Build features
overview: Describe frequency content, left-right relationships, and recent change.
technical: 440 FFT band-power sums + 3 correlations = 443; stack current + 3 prior epochs = 1,772.

label: Select 30
overview: Keep the most useful training-side features for each validation fold.
technical: Fold-local RF impurity selection on inner-train data only.

label: Random Forest
overview: Estimate seizure probability with a patient-specific ensemble.
technical: 500 trees, max depth 12, min leaf 1, sqrt features, balanced subsampling.

label: Form alarms
overview: Smooth probabilities, apply a subject-specific threshold, and reject very short alarms.
technical: Median kernel 5 epochs; threshold selected on inner validation; minimum run 3 epochs.

label: Evaluate events
overview: Measure whether seizures were caught, how often false alarms occurred, and detection delay.
technical: Within-subject, file-level leave-one-seizure-out evaluation; one patient-specific model per subject; no unseen-subject generalisation test.
